observation: I need one place to see whether the lift is working before I leave home.
When a route changes, I copy the same update into three systems.
The accessible pickup point is clear, but the handoff to the shuttle is not.
I want a named person to call when the planned connection disappears.
The service must provide an accessible status update and a human escalation path.
A short reason code would help me explain the delay without guessing.
The recovery message made sense, but I could not tell who owned the next step.
The shared board lets us see the same case state during a handover.
